nodes.title: Clarify-or-default behaviour
nodes.description: Ask when window, segment or metric is ambiguous; on Slack proceed with the stated default after 10 minutes.

nodes.title: Parse the historical SQL corpus into intents
nodes.description: sqlglot over the warehouse query log: tables, columns, filters, aggregates per query, clustered into intents.

nodes.title: Corrections become doc-fix PRs and candidate evals
nodes.description: A scheduled job reads 👎 and correction language, drafts a one-line doc fix tagged to the domain owner. No silent memory.

nodes.title: Name an analyst owner and review cadence per domain
Incentives domain quick reference
nodes.description: Business context, entity grain, standard hygiene filter, dashboards to check first.

nodes.title: Run the evals in CI on every context PR
nodes.description: A PR touching metrics/, domains/ or runbooks/ re-runs the affected slice; two graders, execution match and analyst rubric.

nodes.title: Weekly schema diff opens issues for drift
nodes.description: Diff the metastore against domains/*/tables/; fail data-model PRs that change a documented table without a doc change.

nodes.title: Distill 50–100 atomic evals plus dashboard evals
nodes.description: Pin gold SQL to snapshot dates. Analysts mark each pair canonical or idiosyncratic; only canonical pairs become examples/.

nodes.title: Expose execute_sql over MCP
nodes.description: Two tools in v0: the file tools the coding agent already has, and execute_sql behind the gate.

nodes.title: Write 15–25 analyst-owned metric files
nodes.description: Definition, grain, canonical parameterized SQL, always-on filters, pitfalls, owner, example questions. Human-written; LLM-generated definitions were net-negative elsewhere.

nodes.title: Provenance footer on every answer
nodes.description: Source · Verified yes/no · Reviewed · Freshness (MAX(ds)) · Owner · Query ID.

nodes.title: Log every query with surface, user and conversation
Lay out the knowledge repo
nodes.description: metrics/, domains/, runbooks/, examples/, context/, evals/ plus a thin CLAUDE.md router.

nodes.title: Thin router with a fixed source order
nodes.description: metrics/ first (verified), then domain docs (unverified), then examples/, then context/. Never raw query history.

nodes.title: Write 3–4 runbooks
nodes.description: Campaign readout, regional drop, funnel, cohort compare. Procedural knowledge, separate from the metric files.

nodes.title: Slack surface for PMs and ops
nodes.description: Waiting on the Slack app approval. Reviewer is mandatory for stakeholder-facing and spend-related answers.

nodes.title: Pre-tool-use SQL gate
nodes.description: SELECT only, allowed schemas, mandatory ds filter, LIMIT injected on raw pulls, scan estimate under 500 GB. Deny reasons go back to the model as text.

nodes.title: Adversarial sql-reviewer sub-agent
nodes.description: Same model tier. Checks grain, hygiene filters, join cardinality, window boundaries, and whether a metric file should have been used.

nodes.title: Incrementality and synthetic-control runbooks
nodes.description: Statistical guardrails: pre-period fit, placebo tests, minimum n. Until then, answer cohort questions with data plus a proposed analysis plan.

nodes.title: Document the top ~20 growth tables
nodes.description: Purpose, grain, partition, low-cardinality values, joins, "differs from", gotchas, certification.

nodes.title: v0: growth analysts via Claude Code, incentives only
nodes.description: Exit: ≥ 90% on the incentives eval slice, metric-file hit rate measured, time-saved estimate on 20 real questions.

nodes.title: v1: Slack rollout, every domain gated at ≥ 90%
nodes.description: Exit: correction and 👎 rates tracked weekly; ≥ 70% of Slack answers Verified.

nodes.title: v2: analysis runbooks in production
nodes.description: Exit: analyst sign-off on 20 runbook outputs; canaries stable for 4 weeks.
